attempt_notes: dfba32e9 and 38417b52 failed compiling new test diagnostics (Dtype class is not an enum; then a local logical vector shadowed the dtype helper). No runtime verdict from these attempts. 8627bb80 fixed the diagnostics and passed 21 runtime cases plus two separate header checks on both Macs.

A bounded source check at the pinned mlx/backend/common/compiled.h found that print_float_constant emits every NaN as NAN. A raw-bit Fill->Select compiled-region test was therefore added at 1708fd54. It reproduced BF16 0xffc3 becoming 0x7fc0. Plain Fill and F32/F16 variants passed. This observation identifies a native floating fusion/constant preservation issue; the printer alone is not asserted as the sole internal cause.

c4a0db38 performs floating Select through same-width native integer views and where, then views the result back to its original dtype. Both Macs passed all 22 runtime cases and two header checks. One product correction; no numeric tolerance change, dependency change or custom host payload fallback.

Air uses a clean validation Git checkout populated by bundles from canonical Windows. Mini uses complete canonical git archives with SHA-256 checked before extraction; Mini signs correctness/portability only. Both use Release/WERROR, actual Metal GPU, parallel build 2, serial CTest, disconnected dependency cache.
coverage: Typed metadata preparation and shared Direct/Graph lowering cover F32/F16/BF16 arithmetic, three gates and mixed-F32 RMSNorm/LayerNorm; I32/Bool storage/layout/select. Rank0..8, empty/tail/real 2048 hidden, actual native transpose, broadcasting, slice/reshape/permute, five-way Concat and floating Cast use independent layout/raw-bit and FP64 math/storage-rounding oracles.

NaN, Inf, negative zero and raw floating scalar payloads are checked, including Fill->Select in a compiled native region. Width0/1/127/128/129/257 and norm width2048 cover tails/empty. Norm wrong parameter width, unsupported accumulation and legacy half MatMul reject during preparation.

Graph and Direct run the same mixed norm->gate->residual->Select and sliced-Concat program for F16/BF16, rows0/1/17/23/129 and width129/2048. Same-program bit comparisons are supplemented by an independent FP64 reference with explicit per-operation storage rounding. Two independent invocations, three changed input steps, retained old result, unchanged input and close semantics pass.

Existing native context OOM, cancellation, late failure, drain and ownership regressions run with the owning factors. The two standalone header checks run as configured by the repository; enabled Apple APIs additionally compile through actual native product/test targets. No full package header/delivery claim is made.
